' Cretli managed autostart v1
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
shell.Run "wsl.exe ""-d"" ""Example Linux"" ""--cd"" ""/home/user/my app"" ""--exec"" ""/usr/bin/env"" ""PATH=/home/user/node install/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"" ""/home/user/node install/bin/node"" ""/home/user/my app/scripts/cretli-supervisor.mjs""", 0, False
warnings: WSL: no manager restarts the supervisor itself. Stop it with: '/home/user/node install/bin/node' '/home/user/my app/scripts/cretli-supervisor.mjs' request-stop
activation: Activation at next boot/login; use --apply --start to start explicitly.
